questions.question: Recession is __________.

options.text: reduction in production and employment for want of sufficient demand for goods
rise in the cost of production, especially because of wage increase
increase in money supply without a matching increase in production

questions.solution:
__
 
• Recession is the **reduction in production and employment for want of sufficient demand for goods**__.
 
• In economics, a recession is a business cycle contraction which results in a general slowdown in economic activity.
 
• It is a period of general economic decline, defined usually as a contraction in the GDP for six months marked by high unemployment, stagnant wages, and fall in retail sales.

questions.question: Who of the following is considered as the father of "Green Revolution" in the world?
questions.solution:
Dr. Norman Borlaug

 
 
 
Norman Ernest Borlaug was an American agronomist and humanitarian who led initiatives worldwide that contributed to the extensive increases in agricultural production termed the Green Revolution.

 
 
 

 
 
Dr. MS Swaminathan

 
 
 
Mankombu Sambasivan Swaminathan is an Indian geneticist and international administrator, renowned for his leading role in India's Green Revolution, a program under which high-yield varieties of wheat.

 
 
 

 
 
Dr. Manmohan Singh

 
 
 
Manmohan Singh is an Indian economist and politician who served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014

 
 
 

 
 
 Henry Ford

 
 
 
Henry Ford was a business magnate and the founder of Ford Motors

questions.question: Which of the following minerals is not found in the plateau regions?
questions.solution: Mineral oil is any of various colourless, odourless, light mixtures of higher alkanes from a mineral source, particularly a distillate of petroleum. The mineral oil cannot be found in the plateau regions because of the relative younger age of the plateaus. It is generally found in the sea beds.

questions.question: The Saka Era was founded in the year________.
questions.solution:
• The Saka Era was founded by Kanishka, the emperor of the Kushana empire from the year 78 A.D.
 
• His inscriptions, dated to the years 11 and 52, have been found at Andhau in Kutch region.
 
• The Saka era is a historical calendar era, corresponding to Julian year 78.
 
• It is commonly known in Indian languages as Shalivahana Saka.

questions.question: Which ruler of Vijayanagar allowed the Portuguese to build a church in his empire?
questions.solution: Venkatapati Raya was the younger brother of Sriranga Deva Raya and the ruler of Vijayanagara Empire with bases in Penukonda, Chandragiri and Vellore. questions.question: Which country, on 25 October 2017 announced that it will introduced a minimum wage for workers?
questions.solution: Qatar, on 25 October 2017 announced that it will be introducing a minimum wage for workers. The country has been under global scrutiny over its alleged ill-treatment of migrant labourers. Qatar has one of the highest per capita incomes of 1.25lakh dollars in Purchasing power parity.

questions.question: Who is the winner of the third Indian Council for cultural Relations (ICCR) distinguished indologist award – 2017?
questions.solution:
• The third Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) Distinguished Indologist Award for the year 2017 was awarded to Professor Hiroshi Marui of Japan.
 
• He was presented with this award by President Ram Nath Kovind at a function in Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi. Indology is academic study of history, cultures, languages and literature of India and is a subset of Asian studies.

questions.question: Ping-pong Diplomacy is related to which of the following countries?
questions.solution: Ping-pong diplomacy refers to the exchange of table tennis players between the United States and People's Republic of China in the early 1970s. This form of diplomacy was used to ease out the tensions between the two countries before the cultural revolution of China.

questions.question: What is the valency of magnesium?
questions.solution: Magnesium is a chemical element with symbol Mg and atomic number 12. It is a shiny grey solid which bears a close physical resemblance to the other five elements in the second column of the periodic table.

questions.question: What is the general formula of Alkene?
questions.solution:
In organic chemistry, an alkene is an unsaturated hydrocarbon that contains at least one carbon-carbon double bond. The words alkene and olefin are often used interchangeably.

**The formula of Alkane** - CₙH₍₂ₙ₊₂₎ 

**The formula of Alkene** - CₙH₍₂ₙ₎ 

**The formula of Alkyne** - CₙH₍₂ₙ₋₂₎

questions.question: According to Article 80 of Indian Constitution, Rajya Sabha can have a maximum strength of 250 members. Out of these 250 members how many are representatives of States and Union Territories?
questions.solution:
• The Rajya Sabha or Council of States is the upper house of the Parliament of India. Membership of Rajya Sabha is limited by the Constitution to a maximum of 250 members, and current laws have provision for 245 members.
 
• There are total 245 seats out of which 233 are Elected; 12 Nominated; 4 Vacant (1 Elected and 3 Nominated Seats)

questions.question: Under which Article of Indian Constitution an emergency can be declared on the grounds of failure of constitutional machinery in the States?
questions.solution:
• Article 356 in the Constitution of India is a part of Emergency Provisions to deal with any adverse law and order situation or failure of Constitutional Machinery within a State.

 
• This power can be exercised by President of India only or Governor can also impose Emergency after due consultation with the President.

questions.question: During the day which process is the major driving force in the movement of water in the xylem?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Transpiration pull**

__**EXPLANATION:**__

 
• Transpiration pull or the suction force is the force which aids in drawing the water upward from roots to leaves.
 
• In leaves, some amount of water is used for photosynthesis and excess water is released into the atmosphere through openings called as stomata.

questions.question: Which of the following part of plant cell, is selectively permeable?
questions.solution:
Cell wall

 
 
 
It is a rigid layer of polysaccharides lying outside the plasma membrane of the cells of plants, fungi, and bacteria. In the algae and higher plants, it consists mainly of cellulose.

 
 
 

 
 
__**Cell membrane**__

 
 
 
__**Cell membrane is the semipermeable membrane **__surrounding the cytoplasm of a cell.

 
 
 

 
 
Cytoplasm

 
 
 
It is the material or protoplasm within a living cell, excluding the nucleus.

 
 
 

 
 
Nucleus

 
 
 
The nucleus is an organelle found in eukaryotic cells. Inside its fully enclosed nuclear membrane, it contains the majority of the cell's genetic material.

questions.question: What is the name of world’s first artificial intelligence politician developed by New Zealand?
questions.solution:

questions.question: In October 2017, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) relaxed norms for information utilities. Listed Indian companies can now hold ______ of the paid-up equity share capital or total voting power rights in such firms.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**100%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India 

 
 
• The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) was established on 1st October 2016 under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC).
 
• As the body is created by an act of the parliament, it is a statutory body.
 
• It is a unique regulator: regulates a profession as well as processes.
 
• It has regulatory oversight over the Insolvency Professionals, Insolvency Professional Agencies, Insolvency Professional Entities and Information Utilities. 
 
• It has also been designated as the ‘Authority' under the Companies (Registered Valuers and Valuation Rules), 2017 for regulation and development of the profession of valuers in the country.
 
• Current Chairperson - Ravi Mittal
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some very important terms:

 
• Insolvency:

 
 
• ​Insolvency is a state of financial distress in which a business or person is unable to pay its bills or debts.
 
• This person or business is called Insolvent.
 
 
 
• Bankruptcy:
 
 
• ​Bankruptcy is a legal proceeding involving a person or business that is unable to repay its outstanding debts.
 
 
 
• Liquidation:
 
 
• ​Liquidation in finance and economics is the process of bringing a business to an end and distributing its assets to claimants.

questions.question: What is the heat generated (in J) in a heating element of resistance 1000 Ω when a current of 0.1 A passes through it for 25 seconds?
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT: __

__
 
• When an electric current is passed through a conductor, the conductor becomes hot after some time and produces heat.
 
• This happens due to the conversion of some electric energy passing through the conductor into heat energy. This effect of electric current is called the heating effect of the current or the Joule heating effect.
 
• The appliances based on the heating effect of electric current work on both AC and DC supply.
 
• The amount of heat liberated can be given as 
 
• H = frac{{Pt}}{{4.2}}cal Rightarrow H = W = Pt = {I²}Rt joule

Electric current passing through conductor = IT

The power dissipated across the copper coil = P

Work done by current = W

The resistance of wire = R

Heat dissipated because of current = H

time period = t

CALCULATION:__

Heat generation = P × t

Heat generation = I² × R × t

Where I = Current

R = resistance

t = time

Heat generation = (0.1)² × 1000 × 25

= 250 J

questions.question: 1 pascal equals 1 _________.
questions.solution:
The pascal is the SI derived unit of pressure used to quantify internal pressure, stress, Young's modulus and ultimate tensile strength. It is named after the French polymath Blaise Pascal.

1 pascal = 1 N m⁻²

questions.question: By volume, 78% of air is _________.
questions.solution: The atmosphere of Earth is the layer of gases, commonly known as air, that surrounds the planet Earth and is retained by Earth's gravity. By volume, dry air contains 78.09% nitrogen, 20.95% oxygen, 0.93% argon, 0.04% carbon dioxide, and small amounts of other gases. Air also contains a variable amount of water vapor, on average around 1% at sea level, and 0.4% over the entire atmosphere.

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, _______ provides tools for formatting like bold, italic, underline etc.
questions.solution: The Formatting toolbar is located just below the menu bar. It contains buttons representing commands such as New, Open, Save, and Print. One can customize the buttons that appear on the formatting toolbar using the customize toolbar menu item.
